DIAGNOSIS READY: Krukenberg Tumor (Metastatic Ovarian Cancer from Gastric Primary).

The combination of a large ovarian mass, rapid ascites, shortness of breath, and your age as a nulliparous woman strongly suggests metastatic spread, likely from the gastrointestinal tract, rather than a primary ovarian malignancy.
